name: Fireflies.ai
summary: AI meeting assistant that joins calls as a bot to record, transcribe, summarise and search conversations.

trainingDefault.quote: We do not use personal information for AI model training and we contractually prohibit our vendors from using this information for their own model training.
Your data is never used for AI training or any purpose outside your direct business needs.

subprocessorTraining.quote: we contractually prohibit our vendors from using this information for their own model training

dpa.quote: we invite you to sign our Data Processing Agreement (DPA)

adminEnforcement.quote: Automatically creates, updates, or removes user accounts through your identity provider.

caveats.text: Fireflies says vendors and partners keep meeting data for 0 days; Fireflies itself stores transcripts until you delete them.

evidence.quote: 0-day data retention policy with all vendors and partners.
